about: Every text-rule site that tests/test_no_text_rules.py collects from src/, the delivery-path scripts and the files this ledger names. An `allowed` entry is keyed by (file, fingerprint); a `pending` entry by (file, symbol, sink) and covers every site with that sink in that symbol. A site no entry covers fails the guard.
inventory: docs/inventory/2026-10-12_text_rules.md and .json (repo state ec0cf51; src/ unchanged at 7c63c6d)

kinds.pending: a text rule scheduled for removal, keyed by (file, symbol, sink); it stays while any site with that sink remains in that symbol. Delete it when the last one goes. The pending list only shrinks: every pending key must be in tests/fixtures/text_rule_pending_baseline.json, whose hash is pinned in the guard
kinds.allowed: machine-format parsing or a structured enum / field name (inventory class B, rule 4); the reason says which
kinds.section_locating: a rule that only LOCATES and SPLITS the eligibility section by document format -- section headings, list numbering and bullets, page furniture -- re-admitted by the user on 2026-10-22. Keyed by (file, fingerprint) like allowed, and admitted only in the modules the guard lists in SECTION_LOCATING_MODULES (src/agents/agent1/section_rules.py). A rule that decides what a criterion means (conditional, exception, entity, scope, OR-grouping) is never this kind

inventory_id.A*, S*, C*, D*, E*: the inventory row the site belongs to
inventory_id.B*: the inventory's class-B file entry for the file the site is in
inventory_id.new:B: allowed site in a file the inventory did not list; classified when this ledger was built
inventory_id.new:dead: Class-A-shaped rule the inventory did not list, off the delivery path; classified when this ledger was built
inventory_id.new:2026-10-14: text used as the key of a dict that is not a literal (lookup sink) that the 2026-10-14 guard extension found
inventory_id.new:2026-10-13: text rule the 2026-10-13 guard extension found and the 2026-10-12 inventory did not list as a rule
